description: Use this when a user wants to find or compare product candidates across participating WooCommerce merchants. Search cards include bounded variants_compact and variant_option_values from the merchant snapshot. Option values are independent and do not prove a purchasable combination. Verify the selected variant, price and stock through its merchant Bridge handoff before confirming an offer. For a request with multiple distinct items, search each item independently (calls may run in parallel), then pass the selected p2209_id values together to verify_basket. Use get_product only when a search card lacks needed indexed details.

color.description: Bridge color family (e.g. "blue"). Common aliases are resolved to a family available in the active index. A family match does not guarantee an exact shade; read filter_semantics.color and verify the chosen product via handoff.bridge_product_url.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from a previous global_search with the SAME arguments; returns the next page. A cursor from a different query is rejected.

gender.description: Canonical gender facet. Filtering is discovery-tolerant: untagged and unisex products can remain candidates, so verify the chosen product. Allowed values: female, male, unisex.

in_stock.description: true filters product-level stock in the indexed snapshot. Does not verify a selected variant or a booking slot.

leaf.description: Canonical category node. Accepts a terminal leaf (e.g. beverages.alcohol.sparkling_prosecco) or any parent node (e.g. jewellery, home.bedroom): a parent matches the node and its whole subtree, so you can widen or narrow the search by moving up or down the tree. Use list_categories to browse the tree.

limit.description: Max offers per page (1-25, default 10). Use next_cursor for the next page.

max_price.description: Upper bound in major currency units (for example 1550 means EUR 1,550 for EUR offers). A matching range may include variants above this bound; verify the chosen variant. Per-offer currency, no FX conversion.

merchant.description: Restrict to one merchant: merchant_id as returned in result_facets.merchants or offers (e.g. "duinshop-it") or its domain.

min_price.description: Lower bound in major currency units (for example 50 means EUR 50 for EUR offers). Matches overlapping variant price ranges in each offer currency; no FX conversion. Verify the chosen variant.

price_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of min_price/max_price (e.g. EUR). With it, only offers priced in that currency are returned; without it the bounds compare numbers in each offer's own currency. Needs min_price or max_price.

q.description: Free-text product query. Each term must match as a whole word in the native merchant catalog text (name, short description, description) or in the canonical category path, so English category terms reach catalogs written in other languages: q="mattress" returns products under home.bedroom.mattress even when their text is Italian. There is no server-side translation of product text; for language-neutral retrieval by category use leaf and the canonical filters.

result_facets.description: true adds result_facets: counts over ALL matching offers (not just this page) by merchant, category leaf, brand, availability, and price quartiles per currency. Use them to narrow the next call.

variant.description: Constraints that must ALL hold on the SAME variant. Keys and values are the merchant's own, in any language or script (read variant_vocabulary first): {"pa_taglia":"L"}, {"size":["L","Large"]}, {"*":["rouge","rosso"]} (* = any option), or [{"keys":["pa_taglia","size"],"values":["L","Large"]}] across merchants. KaliCart never translates: pass every value you accept. match.kind: exact (ignoring case, Latin accents, separators) or normalized (same number+unit symbol, NxN, size code). Indexed snapshot: verify on the merchant before quoting.

variant_facets.description: true adds variant_vocabulary: real option keys and values with variant and in-stock counts, for the offers returned or, with no q, for the merchant (or all merchants). Use it to choose the values to pass in variant.

variant_facets_limit.description: Max values per option key in variant_vocabulary (1-200, default 40); values_total is always the full count

variant_in_stock.description: true keeps only variants whose own availability is in_stock

variant_limit.description: Max matching variants returned per offer (1-500, default 50); matching_variant_count is always the full count

variant_price_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of variant_price_min/max (e.g. EUR). With it, only variants priced in that currency satisfy the bound; no FX conversion. Without it, bounds compare numbers in each variant's own currency.

variant_price_max.description: Upper bound on the variant price (major units)

variant_price_min.description: Lower bound on the variant price (major units)

name: global_search
title: Search products across merchants
